description: Render a Markdown outline into a standalone HTML mind map — interactive, single file, no network needed. Call this after you have written or refined an outline. Returns the file path; it does not overwrite an existing file unless you ask it to.

branding.description: Add a small "Made with mindlm-mcp" footer link (default false).

colorFreezeLevel.description: Stop changing branch colour below this level.

initialExpandLevel.description: Levels expanded on open; -1 expands everything.

markdown.description: The Markdown outline to render: one "# " root, "##"/"###", then "-" bullets.

maxWidth.description: Maximum node width in pixels; 0 means unlimited.

offline.description: Inline every script so the file works with no network (default true).

outputPath.description: Output file or directory. Defaults to $MINDMAP_OUTPUT_DIR or ./mindmaps/.

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists (default false).

returnHtml.description: Include the full HTML in the result. Only useful for small maps (default false).

title.description: Page title. Defaults to the outline root.

toolbar.description: Show the zoom / fit / expand toolbar (default true).

name: export_mindmap
title: Export a mind map
